Got questions?

FREQUENTLY ASKED.

Quick answers on registration fees, multi-event rules, prizes, and venue logistics.

Registration & Fee What does the ₹250 registration fee cover?

The ₹250 registration fee is an all-inclusive single pass. It grants you full access to participate in events across any of the 7 departments, provides an official participation certificate, and includes complimentary lunch and refreshments for the day.

Events & Rules Can I participate in multiple events across different departments?

Yes! Your single registration allows you to enter both technical and non-technical events across different departments, provided their schedules and time slots do not overlap.

Registration & Fee Who is eligible to participate in VIYUGAM 2K26?

Undergraduate and postgraduate students from any recognized engineering college, university, or polytechnic institution are eligible. Students from all branches and all academic years (1st through 4th year) are welcome.

Events & Rules Are inter-college and inter-department teams allowed?

Yes, absolutely. For team events, members can belong to different departments or even different colleges. You can indicate your team name during registration or at the check-in desk.

Registration & Fee How do I pay and verify my registration?

Submit your details on the Register page, then proceed to the Payment page. Pay ₹250 via the official UPI QR code and enter your UTR / transaction reference number. Your registration status will be confirmed once verified.
